items.name: audit_security
items.description: Performs comprehensive multi-language security & vulnerability health audit. Scans code for SAST security antipatterns (Command Injection, Path Traversal, Hardcoded Secrets/Keys, Insecure Shell/Eval, Unsafe Blocks) across Rust, JS/TS, Python, Go, and Shell. Performs offline SCA dependency vulnerability audit against 283,000+ indexed advisories (CVE/GHSA/OSV) for Cargo.lock, package.json, requirements.txt, and go.mod. Evaluates runtime posture and returns health score.

items.name: TCP Port Auditor
items.description: Fast asynchronous socket-based TCP port scanner and service prober

items.name: web_security_audit
items.description: Comprehensive web security and defense posture audit: vulnerability analysis, HSTS/CSP/CORS headers, sensitive file leak detection (/.env, /.git), DOM client-side secrets hunter (API keys), DoH DNS Matrix, Certificate Transparency subdomains, and WHOIS/RDAP reconnaissance.
